form.name: Accrual Name
form.nameInfo: Descriptive label for the accrued obligation.
form.supplierContractInfo: The contract whose cycle is being accrued.
form.supplierInfo: Supplier the obligation is owed to. Defaults from the contract.
form.recognitionDateInfo: Date the obligation is booked into the period.
form.periodStartInfo: Start of the period the accrual covers.
form.periodEndInfo: End of the period the accrual covers.
form.cycleDateInfo: Cycle bucket (YYYY-MM-DD) used for idempotency against the recurrence engine.
form.accruedAmountInfo: Estimated obligation for the period, in the accrual currency.
form.settledAmountInfo: Sum of settlements applied so far. Read-only; updated by Settle Accrual.
form.remainingAmountInfo: Accrued amount minus settled amount. Read-only.
form.statusInfo: Lifecycle state. New accruals default to Outstanding and progress as settlements arrive.
form.expenseAccountInfo: GL account to debit when the obligation is recognized.
form.accrualAccountInfo: GL account to credit while the accrual is outstanding.

confirm.reverseMessage: Reversing flips this accrual to Reversed and posts a reversing journal. If a linked bill has already been disbursed, you will need a separate disbursement reversal to reconcile cash. Continue?
